# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie Tulk attends school out of a desire for an education rather than out of financial necessity.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)_

## Personality

Flossie is quick to ask questions and frequently speaks her mind. She exhibits a sharp, caustic tongue and can be patronizing or blunt toward her peers. Although she claims to despise creative school activities and can be uncharitable, she is capable of polite and friendly behavior on occasion.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)_

## Traits

- Caustic-tongued  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Inquisitive  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)</sub>
- Superstitious  <sub>[v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007)</sub>
- Patronizing  <sub>[v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- Gain an education  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school under Miss Thorne, where she openly expressed her dislike for recitation afternoons. At the conclusion of one school session, she directly questioned Miss Thorne about whether she would be returning the following year. She later traveled alongside classmates to take the entrance examinations at the Academy, where she remarked to Nell Harcourt about her pale appearance and warned her about the bad luck of being assigned number thirteen. After entering Regent's, she became known as the most caustic-tongued student in her class. Later, Flossie and her family hosted a send-off celebration for Nell and Hugh Carrow organized by the B.V.I.S., during which she behaved politely and offered a patronizing compliment to Nell on her new dress.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c2 P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)_
